package.name: qore-pdfium
package.title: PDFium renderer for Qore
package.description: Pinned PDFium 148 shared C API with offline upstream tests, complete notices and source-level debug packages. Candidate x86_64 RPMs and installed API/unload controls pass on Fedora, AlmaLinux and openSUSE; OBS qualifies the committed source natively on both architectures.
